facts.fact: Voices is described as having over one million members and as the largest marketplace for audio and voice over products and services in the world.
facts.quote: With over one million members, Voices is the largest marketplace for audio and voice over products and services in the world.

facts.fact: Voices gives marketers access to a global network of voice actors available in over 100 languages, accents and dialects.
facts.quote: Through Voices, marketers can access a global network of voice actors available to lend their talents in over 100 languages, accents and dialects

facts.fact: Voices states it has helped service clients and voice talent in over 160 countries, per its own 'About Voices' description.
facts.quote: Headquartered in London, Canada, Voices helps service clients and voice talent in over 160 countries.

facts.fact: Voices has been trusted by brands since 2005, according to its own 'About Voices' description.
facts.quote: Since 2005, the biggest and most beloved brands have entrusted Voices to help them find their voice.
